evidence_boundaries: Amini et al. is a start-to-end numerical study tied to an APS formal record; no accelerator experiment was performed in this work.
Howard et al. and Carle et al. analyze complementary observables from the same LM26 LMC-12 shot and are not independent repetition.
Huang et al. combines a direct Cu-wire proof experiment with FLASH and atomic-model synthesis for ICF scenarios; it does not demonstrate ignition or burn.
Qiu et al. is a two-dimensional PIC mechanism study; its model counts are not an end-to-end absolute laser-driven source yield.
Campos Pinto et al. validates low-dimensional kinetic benchmarks; competitive five-dimensional performance was not demonstrated.
No accelerator, MagLIF, ICF, PIC, XFEL or neural-network simulation was reproduced locally.
